name: Calatayud

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Most of Calatayud's vineyards sit high, between 650 and 900 m, and the altitude decides when each style is picked.
Young reds are deep cherry to garnet, fruity, fleshy and balanced, with soft tannin and a long finish.
Rosés are strawberry to raspberry pink, intensely floral and fruity, fresh and powerful.
Calatayud Superior is a deep red, with fruit, balsamic, mineral, toast and spice aromas.
In Crianza reds, tannins firm in youth round out in bottle.

blurb.text: An Aragón DO shown here with Campo de Borja. Garnacha Tinta, Tempranillo and Macabeo are among its allowed grapes.
